lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਆਖਣੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam soee tudh bhaavasee hor aakhan bahut apaar ||
lines.translation: The Hukam of Your Command is the pleasure of Your Will, Lord. To say anything else is far beyond anyone's reach.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਪੂਛਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa paatisaahu poochh na kare beechaar ||4||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the True King does not seek advice from anyone else in His decisions. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਉਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa hor saunaa khusee khuaar ||
lines.translation: O Baba, the pleasure of other sleep is false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਤੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jit sutai tan peeReeai man mahi chalahi vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||4||7||
lines.translation: By such sleep, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||4||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਗੂ ਕੀ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਲਲਿਤਾ ਅਗਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ku(n)goo kee kaa(n)iaa ratanaa kee lalitaa agar vaas tan saas ||
lines.translation: With the body of saffron, and the tongue a jewel, and the breath of the body pure fragrant incense;

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਟਿਕਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਮਤਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: athasath teerath kaa mukh tikaa tit ghat mat vigaas ||
lines.translation: with the face anointed at the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, and the heart illuminated with wisdom

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਤੁ ਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ot matee saalaahanaa sach naam gunataas ||1||
lines.translation: -with that wisdom, chant the Praises of the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਰ ਹੋਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa hor mat hor hor ||
lines.translation: O Baba, other wisdom is useless and irrelevant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਵੇਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: je sau ver kamaaeeai kooRai kooRaa jor ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: If falsehood is practiced a hundred times, it is still false in its effects. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਜ ਲਗੈ ਪੀਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooj lagai peer aakheeai sabh milai sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: You may be worshipped and adored as a Pir (a spiritual teacher); you may be welcomed by all the world;

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਸਦਾਏ ਆਪਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਿਧੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naau sadaae aapanaa hovai sidh sumaar ||
lines.translation: you may adopt a lofty name, and be known to have supernatural spiritual powers

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭਾ ਪੂਜ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jaa pat lekhai naa pavai sabhaa pooj khuaar ||2||
lines.translation: -even so, if you are not accepted in the Court of the Lord, then all this adoration is false. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਥਾਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau satigur thaapiaa tin met na sakai koi ||
lines.translation: No one can overthrow those who have been established by the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: onaa a(n)dar naam nidhaan hai naamo paragat hoi ||
lines.translation: The Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is within them, and through the Naam, they are radiant and famous.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਅਖੰਡੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naau poojeeai naau ma(n)neeai akha(n)d sadaa sach soi ||3||
lines.translation: They worship the Naam, and they believe in the Naam. The True One is forever Intact and Unbroken. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khehoo kheh ralaaeeai taa jeeu kehaa hoi ||
lines.translation: When the body mingles with dust, what happens to the soul?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲੀਆ ਸਭਿ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaleeaa sabh siaanapaa uthee chaliaa roi ||
lines.translation: All clever tricks are burnt away, and you shall depart crying.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਦਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam visaariai dar gaiaa kiaa hoi ||4||8||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who forget the Naam-what will happen when they go to the Court of the Lord? ||4||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਵੀਥਰੈ ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਝੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gunava(n)tee gun veetharai augunava(n)tee jhoor ||
lines.translation: The virtuous wife exudes virtue; the unvirtuous suffer in misery.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਵਰੁ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪਿਰ ਕੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: je loRahi var kaamanee nah mileeai pir koor ||
lines.translation: If you long for your Husband Lord, O soul-bride, you must know that He is not met by falsehood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹੜਾ ਨਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naa beRee naa tulahaRaa naa paaeeai pir door ||1||
lines.translation: No boat or raft can take you to Him. Your Husband Lord is far away. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਅਡੋਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere thaakur poorai takhat adol ||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master is Perfect; His Throne is Eternal and Immovable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh pooraa je kare paaeeai saach atol ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: One who attains perfection as Gurmukh, obtains the Immeasurable True Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh harima(n)dar sohanaa tis mahi maanak laal ||
lines.translation: The Palace of the Lord God is so beautiful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਤੀ ਹੀਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋਟ ਰੀਸਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: motee heeraa niramalaa ka(n)chan kot reesaal ||
lines.translation: Within it, there are gems, rubies, pearls and flawless diamonds. A fortress of gold surrounds this Source of Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਉੜੀ ਗੜਿ ਕਿਉ ਚੜਉ ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bin pauRee gaR kiu chaRau gur har dhiaan nihaal ||2||
lines.translation: How can I climb up to the Fortress without a ladder? By meditating on the Lord, through the Guru, I am blessed and exalted. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਉੜੀ ਬੇੜੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur pauRee beRee guroo gur tulahaa har naau ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the Ladder, the Guru is the Boat, and the Guru is the Raft to take me to the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sar saagar bohitho gur teerath dareeaau ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the Boat to carry me across the world-ocean; the Guru is the Sacred Shrine of Pilgrimage, the Guru is the Holy River.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਊਜਲੀ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਣ ਜਾਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: je tis bhaavai oojalee sat sar naavan jaau ||3||
lines.translation: If it pleases Him, I bathe in the Pool of Truth, and become radiant and pure. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੋ ਪੂਰੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooro pooro aakheeai poorai takhat nivaas ||
lines.translation: He is called the Most Perfect of the Perfect. He sits upon His Perfect Throne.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorai thaan suhaavanai poorai aas niraas ||
lines.translation: He looks so Beautiful in His Perfect Place. He fulfills the hopes of the hopeless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਉ ਘਾਟੈ ਗੁਣ ਤਾਸ ॥੪॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak pooraa je milai kiu ghaatai gun taas ||4||9||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if one obtains the Perfect Lord, how can his virtues decrease? ||4||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਭੈਣੇ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavahu bhaine gal milah a(n)k sahelaReeaah ||
lines.translation: Come, my dear sisters and spiritual companions; hug me close in your embrace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਹ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਕੰਤ ਕੀਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil kai karah kahaaneeaa sa(n)mrath ka(n)t keeaah ||
lines.translation: Let's join together, and tell stories of our All-powerful Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਅਉਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਅਸਾਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saache saahib sabh gun augan sabh asaah ||1||
lines.translation: All Virtues are in our True Lord and Master; we are utterly without virtue. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: karataa sabh ko terai jor ||
lines.translation: O Creator Lord, all are in Your Power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek sabad beechaareeai jaa too taa kiaa hor ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I dwell upon the One Word of the Shabad. You are mine-what else do I need? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤੁਸੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਕਿਨੀ ਗੁਣਂੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaai puchhahu sohaaganee tusee raaviaa kinee guna(n)ee ||
lines.translation: Go, and ask the happy soul-brides, "By what virtuous qualities do you enjoy your Husband Lord?"

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj sa(n)tokh seegaareeaa mithaa bolanee ||
lines.translation: "We are adorned with intuitive ease, contentment and sweet words.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਰੀਸਾਲੂ ਤਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pir reesaaloo taa milai jaa gur kaa sabad sunee ||2||
lines.translation: We meet with our Beloved, the Source of Joy, when we listen to the Word of the Guru's Shabad." ||2||
